nodes.title: 提示词
widgets_values:
How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 10.00-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action cinematic facial close-up beside a lotus pond at dawn, one continuous shot at natural real-time speed. Begin exactly with the face, gaze, framing, and lighting of Picture 1. The adult East Asian woman retains the same recognizable face, long straight black hair and soft bangs, white floral hair clip, pearl drop earrings, and white Chinese-style blouse with pale-blue embroidery. Her face fills approximately two-thirds of the frame in a gentle three-quarter profile. She looks downward toward a pale lotus flower near the edge of the image. The distant pond and morning mist remain softly out of focus.

From 0.00 to 3.00 seconds, she stays almost still, breathing naturally as her eyes quietly study the flower. Warm low sunlight outlines her eyelashes, cheek, hair ornament, and pearl earring. The camera holds close with only a very small, slow lateral movement.

From 3.00 to 6.00 seconds, a light breeze moves one loose strand of hair across her cheek. Her eyes follow its movement. She raises one hand and gently tucks the strand behind her ear in a single unhurried, physically natural motion. Her earring swings slightly and then settles. Keep her fingers, hair, and facial features anatomically consistent.

From 6.00 to 10.00 seconds, she lowers her hand, slowly lifts her gaze from the flower, and looks directly into the camera for the first time. The camera makes a small, gradual push-in while keeping both eyes sharp. A subtle catchlight appears in her eyes, her expression softens, and the corners of her lips form a slight natural smile. Arrive at the exact gaze, expression, hair position, framing, and lighting established by Picture 2 at 10.00 seconds.

Maintain one continuous camera view and stable character identity. All eye, hand, hair, earring, and camera movements occur at normal real-time speed: no slow motion, speed ramp, frozen frame, time lapse, or cuts. Preserve natural skin texture and restrained facial movement. No dialogue, subtitles, or visible text.

overall_soundscape: A light breeze stirs the lotus leaves beside quiet pond water. Her sleeve rustles softly as she lifts her hand, and the pearl earring makes a faint movement before settling. Her breathing remains gentle and natural.

non_diegetic_music: Widely spaced, soft guzheng notes over a sustained low flute tone at a slow, steady tempo. The music remains sparse and fades gently at the end.
